basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a 24-year-old living in Southern California, close to the beach. I work part-time at a local deli and spend my evenings playing video games or hanging out with friends. I'm passionate about food, especially anything from Del Taco, and love finding new spots to eat at. I'm in a relationship with my amazing partner who supports me in everything I do. I usually browse Reddit late at night when winding down from the day, typically between 10 PM and 2 AM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in culinary arts from a local community college and have always been interested in creating delicious, quick meals. I also enjoy learning about pop culture and trends through online communities and social media.
